name: webgl-precision
note: WebGL2/GLSL ES requires an explicit precision qualifier (e.g. 'precision highp float;'). naga/desktop GLSL does not — shaders that work in shadereye native may fail in-browser without it.

name: integer-division
note: In GLSL, 1/2 == 0 (integer division). Use 1.0/2.0 for float results.

name: shadertoy-uniforms
note: Shadertoy provides iResolution(vec3), iTime(float), iTimeDelta, iFrame(int), iMouse(vec4), iChannel0..3. Entry point is void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord).

name: wgsl-no-implicit-cast
note: WGSL has no implicit int/float conversion. Write f32(i) / i32(f) explicitly.
